tldr: Evening batch, Aug 9: the agent-safety reckoning hits its first brake — OpenAI pauses Astra development over offensive-cyber risk while Google dismantles DeepMind as Hassabis exits. On the science side, DiffusionGemma proves text diffusion can be retrofitted at <10% of training cost (256 parallel tokens), and WeatherNext's Nature paper buys an extra day of cyclone warning. Tencent teases WorldClaw for 3D world generation, an AMD/llama.cpp patch lifts Qwen 27B context to 149K, AI slop floods Britain's employment courts, LG open-weights K-EXAONE 2.0 (750B), and agent-infra funding rolls on with Acrab's $130M.

articles.title: OpenAI Pauses Astra Work Over Offensive-Cyber Risk
articles.summary: OpenAI halts Astra work over fears it could autonomously weaponize software vulnerabilities — the first voluntary frontier slowdown on cyber risk.

articles.title: Google Dismantles DeepMind as Hassabis Heads for the Exit
articles.summary: Demis Hassabis steps aside to an Alphabet chairman role, Jeff Dean leaves to found a company, and DeepMind folds into Google proper.

articles.title: DiffusionGemma: Retrofit a Model, Don't Train From Scratch
articles.summary: DeepMind converted Gemma 4 into a text-diffusion model using <10% of the original training budget — 256 parallel tokens at ~1,500 tok/s.

articles.title: DeepMind's WeatherNext Predicts Cyclones a Full Day Earlier
articles.summary: Nature-published WeatherNext gives an extra day of cyclone lead time; models open-sourced including a single-TPU mini variant.

articles.title: Tencent Announces WorldClaw for 3D World Generation
articles.summary: Tencent's Hunyuan3D-WorldClaw promises interactive 3D world generation; the community hopes for open weights so it can run locally.

articles.title: AMD llama.cpp Patch: Qwen 27B Context 64K → 149K
articles.summary: Reducing MTP buffer overhead in llama.cpp lifts Qwen 27B available context from 64K to 149K tokens on ROCm — a pure memory-accounting win.

articles.title: LG Open-Weights K-EXAONE 2.0: 750B-Parameter Korean Model
articles.summary: LG's Apache-2.0 K-EXAONE 2.0 (750B, 37B active), built under a Korean government program, posts ~30% coding gains and strong long-context retrieval.

articles.title: AI Slop Is Flooding Britain's Employment Courts
articles.summary: Employment claims rose 39%, many written with ChatGPT or Grok; backlog jumped 55% to 64,000 cases with AI filings citing fabricated laws.

articles.title: Nvidia Pours $3B Into Power as Amazon Builds a 7.65GW Gas Plant
articles.summary: Nvidia invests up to $3B in Lancium (4GW in Texas) while Amazon builds a 7.65GW gas plant emitting 33M tons of CO2/year — AI power at utility scale.

articles.title: Acrab Raises $130M for Agentic AI Compute Platform
articles.summary: Singapore's Acrab banks $130M Series B (Vertex) for its agentic compute platform, after $350M+ cumulative funding and the GELIX 1 Agent Box.

articles.title: GPT-Live in ChatGPT Voice Gains Files and Projects
articles.summary: OpenAI's voice mode now supports file uploads and project context, letting users analyze documents and reference ongoing work in voice conversations.
